question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Agree — Expressing the sense of the House of Representatives that the President should prioritize securing the release of Pastor Jin Mingri, Pastor Gao Quanfu and his wife Pang Yu, Dr. Gulshan Abbas, and Jimmy Lai detained by the People’s Republic of China during future engagements with Chinese President Xi Jinping (H RES 1259)
bill_title: Expressing the sense of the House of Representatives that the President should prioritize securing the release of Pastor Jin Mingri, Pastor Gao Quanfu and his wife Pang Yu, Dr. Gulshan Abbas, and Jimmy Lai detained by the People’s Republic of China during future engagements with Chinese President Xi Jinping.
plain_language: This resolution calls on the President to prioritize the humanitarian release of five named individuals detained by China (Pastor Jin Mingri, Pastor Gao Quanfu and his wife Pang Yu, Dr. Gulshan Abbas, and Jimmy Lai) and others during future engagements with China's President Xi Jinping. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports agreeing to it; a Nay opposes it.
